Compares the schema sent with the node's schema.json and, for each linked Data Map (one after a source, one before a destination, through nodes without tables), lists the tables the save adds, changes or removes that the Data Map lacks, has otherwise, or has. Tables the user said not to ask about again are left out. Nothing is written.
